Build In Style

Tuesday, March 9th, 2027

Summit County ReStore

Support our Women Build Project and connect with other amazing women in our community. Enjoy shopping for fashion accessories, a delicious lunch, and exciting raffle prizes. Together, we’re building a home for a local female homeowner.

Gleneagles Golf Club

  • Welcome Home Social

    Welcome Home Social

    5:30 pm-9:30 pm
    2026.09.03

    Join us on Thursday, September 3rd, from 5:30 PM – 9:30 PM at The Duck Club at 7 17 Credit Union Park (300 South Main Street, Akron) for an unforgettable evening! We’re stepping up to the plate with a fresh new look and venue, bringing the community together for premium bourbon and craft beer tastings, heavy appetizers, and an exciting Akron RubberDucks baseball game—all to support local families building a place to call home.

    1. Full Event Ticket: VIP Social & Tasting Pass Get the complete experience! This pass gives you full entry to the event at The Duck Club.

    • Includes: Duck Club access, heavy appetizers, bourbon & craft beer tasting tickets (or Designated Driver option), and admission to the RubberDucks game.

    • 👉 [Click Here to Purchase VIP Event Tickets] (or visit hfhsummitcounty.org/welcomehomesocial)

    2. QuAkron Gives Back Ticket: Game-Only Ticket Attending with kids or looking to enjoy the ballgame from general stadium seating? You can still support Habitat for Humanity!

    • Includes: Standard stadium seating for the RubberDucks game + a direct donation to our fundraising goal.

    • 👉 [Click Here to Purchase Game-Only Tickets]

    3. Raffle Ticket: Bourbon Bottle Raffle Can’t make it to the game, or want another chance to take home something special? Enter our Bourbon Bottle Raffle!

    • Includes: Raffle entries for a chance to win premium bottled bourbon. (Note: This ticket is for the raffle drawing only and does not include admission to the game or Duck Club).

    • 👉 [Click Here to Purchase Bourbon Raffle Tickets]

    11:35 am-1:00 pm
    2026.09.25
